Northwind Controller Firmware Release Notes

Version 4.3.1
Fixed a race condition that caused intermittent E-217 encoder faults on J4.
Improved boot time from 38 s to 22 s.

Version 4.3.0
Added collision detection sensitivity levels 1 through 5.
Deprecated the legacy Modbus RTU interface; it will be removed in 5.0.

Version 4.2.0
Introduced auto-tuning for joints J1 to J3.
